translation: Took place in the posad [town name omitted by clerk], 1 September 1890, 8 PM. Appeared personally Szmul [unclear: Miara], trader, 40, and Berek Kołtun, laborer, 65, both residing in posad Serock, and declared that yesterday at 6 PM in posad Serock died Bejla [unclear: Miara], two and a half years of age, daughter of Moszek and Frajda née [unclear: Kohn/Kac]. Upon eyewitness certification of the death of Bejla [unclear: Miara] this act was read to the witnesses, signed by us and one witness; the second witness is illiterate.
